threshold_basis: deduplicated retained canonical stable-ID union within a semantic partition

no_loss_precision_refinement.method: dual-lane visible Title/Abstract metadata priority subset
no_loss_precision_refinement.preservation_rule: The source-native broad canonical-ID union remains authoritative. Metadata-negative/body-only matches are retained rather than discarded, so the refinement cannot lose a source match.
no_loss_precision_refinement.source_field_limit: Link validates a Title advanced field but exposes no independently validated Abstract-only field. A source Title restriction would lose abstract/body matches, so it was not adopted.
no_loss_precision_refinement.pair_limit: Link has no supported proximity operator. The local Title/Abstract check tests declared pairs in either order with at most five intervening lexical tokens; body-text pair status remains unknown.
